close_reason: Verified in code — implementation matches decision exactly.
description: Free-text MDN fields (subject, textBody, reportingUA, finalRecipient, extensionFields keys/values) are checked for CR or LF before building the RFC 5322 message. Bad entries are placed in notSent with invalidProperties rather than aborting the whole request. This matches JMAP's partial-success model and prevents a single invalid entry from blocking all legitimate sends in the same request. The guard also prevents header-injection attacks into the generated RFC 5322 output.
title: DECISION: CRLF injection guard is per-entry, not whole-request
